Every day you’re juggling people, projects , and expectations. There are tasks to do, discussions to have, decisions to make, files to share, deadlines to hit, relationships to manage, and work to deliver. This all has to happen somewhere. But you’ve discovered that spreading everything across different apps, browser tabs, emails, and chats doesn’t work. You need a system. Unfortunately, most project management systems are bloated, complicated, and confusing. And software that’s hard to use doesn’t get used. 20 years ago we were in the same boat. We needed something capable, but also straightforward, easy, and reliable . Nothing fit. So we invented Basecamp, and have been improving it ever since. In software, longevity like this isn’t luck — it’s proof it works. And in 2026 we released the all-new Basecamp 5 , packing decades of experience into our best version yet. Today, Basecamp is used across every industry, and nearly a million people, teams, companies, and non-profits worldwide rely on it daily for all sorts of things . Thanks for checking us out. We invite you to give Basecamp a try. And ultimately, we’d be honored to have you as a customer. Play this 1-minute video We asked our customers: “What changed for the better since you switched to Basecamp?” Simply put, we get more work done, quicker, and better. Productivity is up. Errors are down. Clients are happier. Patrick Sheffield, Moore Communications Group Since using Basecamp, our communication is drastically better and deadlines are met without drama. Shannon Kropf, Full Sail University Info is flowing like water. A lot more transparency. Everyone is on the same page. No more secrets and blindspots. Aaron Bingaman, Penn State OEM I no longer have to wonder whether I’ve asked for something… Every member of my team is more accountable. John Drover, Roebothan McKay Marshall Basecamp makes us tighter as a group. Basecamp makes it easy to create shared understanding in our company. Teddy Zetterlund, Lägenhetsbyte We don’t have to contact each other about every little thing. When we need to know something, it’s right there. Kelly Hunter, Chamber Nation Our church is loving Basecamp. It’s so easy to use even the 80-year-olds on our committee are using it! Blake Rider, St. Stephen’s Episcopal Church It eliminated the need for extra communication and reduced a lot of miscommunication between my team. Anthony Clark, Clark Partners Realty Group How about a quick demonstration? No slides, no sales pitch. Just a real project, clicked through in real time. A wonderful way to get comfortable with Basecamp. See how Basecamp works Remember when companies cared about service? We still do! Staffed by incredible humans, we’re here for you 24/7/365. Meet Eron, our Head of Technical Ops Durable infrastructure Rather than rent cloud hosting, we own and run our hardware across multiple data centers. We specified the hardware, configured (and sometimes invented) the software, and optimized every detail for speed and reliability. We’ve maintained an industry-leading 99.99% uptime record for years. Meet Chase, our Head of Support Dependable customer service At most companies, customer service is treated as an afterthought, something to outsource, a place to cut costs. At Basecamp it’s one of our best features. Our customers consistently rave about our kind, patient, and deeply knowledgeable staff. Everyone on the team can answer any question. Want to see a live demo and ask some questions first? We’ll show you how to set up Basecamp in minutes, how to roll it out to your team, and Q\u0026A covering anything else you’d like to ask. See all upcoming classes . Have a great day! Join more than 200,000 people who get our email newsletter.
